dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate trailing edge characterized by a concave spline with a significant structural notch located approximately at the vertical midpoint between the apex and the posterior insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius; lacks acute tapering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40 to 45 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 base width to vertical height ratio.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch is missing from the mid-section of the trailing edge. Multiple small, light-colored circular scars or punctate lesions are visible across the lateral surface of the fin and dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Entire visible surface exhibits a granular texture and specular highlights due to high-density water droplet coverage.
